prompt: Which Meta Quest models released after 2023 use Touch Plus controllers and have 6 cameras?
answer: The **Meta Quest 3S** is the model released after 2023 that uses **Touch Plus controllers** and has **six cameras**—two RGB passthrough cameras and four infrared tracking cameras. It was released on **October 15, 2024**.
